d:
Serengeti National Park is iconic, endless and on every traveller's bucket list!
After everything we experienced in Episode 1, we stayed in Tanzania a little longer and believe me, this second chapter of our journey took things to a whole new level.
In this one, we've explored some of Tanzania’s most iconic landscapes:
• Drove into the Ngorongoro Crater
Stood at the edge of history at the Olduvai Gorge & literally drove through the national park just to make it in time.
